scripts.start: npm run build:lib && ng serve showcase
scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:example
scripts.test: npm run build:lib && ng test ui --watch=false && ng test showcase --watch=false
scripts.pack: npm run build:lib && npm pack ./dist/ui --pack-destination artifacts
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run build && npm run pack
scripts.format: prettier --write projects e2e scripts README.md CHANGELOG.md *.json *.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check projects e2e scripts README.md CHANGELOG.md *.json *.ts
scripts.release:dry-run: npm run build:lib && npm publish ./dist/ui --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org --dry-run
scripts.release:check: npm run verify && npm run check:package && npm run release:dry-run
scripts.publish:npm: npm run release:check && npm publish ./dist/ui --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org
